brief: 6 supplements I actually still take after 3 years of testing.

slots.headline: 6 Supplements I Actually Still Take?
slots.subtitle: Three years of testing. These are the only ones that survived.

slots.title: Magnesium For Better Sleep
slots.body: I tried citrate, oxide, and malate. Glycinate is the only form that actually calms my nervous system without sending me to the bathroom. I take 400mg about an hour before bed. Sleep is deeper and wake-ups are rare.

slots.title: Daily D3 And K2
slots.body: Tested my levels twice a year. D3 alone is fine, but K2 directs calcium to bones instead of arteries. I take 4000 IU with breakfast. It is the cheapest longevity hedge I know.

slots.title: Omega-3 For Brain Health
slots.body: I chased focus with nootropics for months. Turns out my diet was low in EPA. Two grams daily cleared the mental fog and helped my joints feel less crunchy. Third-party tested only.

slots.title: Five Grams Of Creatine
slots.body: It is not just for gym bros. I noticed better recall and easier high-intensity sessions within two weeks. Five grams a day, no loading phase. The research stack is decades deep.

slots.title: Ashwagandha For Cortisol Control
slots.body: My cortisol was chronically elevated on blood work. KSM-66 brought it down in eight weeks. I cycle four weeks on, one week off. Anxiety is lower and afternoons feel less like a crash.

slots.title: Zinc Picolinate Before Bed
slots.body: I kept getting run down every winter. Adding 15mg of zinc picolinate changed that. I take it away from magnesium and coffee. Simple, cheap, and the data on immune support is solid.

slots.headline: Find What Works
slots.body: Start one at a time, track for thirty days, and test your levels. More is not better; targeted is.
